subject: Renewal negotiation: staggered credits + interim price lock
messages:
From: Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@auroratech.com>
To: vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@auroratech.com>, procurement@auroratech.com
Date: Sat, 12 Jun 2027 21:05:00 +0000
Subject: Renewal conversation — capacity bump and price hold request

Hi Vanessa,

Hope you're well. Our renewal with Redwood is coming up on July 18 and we've been running a spike in demand — we expect a 35–45% increase in monthly token consumption starting in August. Before we lock in the new term, procurement and finance asked whether Redwood can: (1) provide a short-term price lock through Q3 while we validate usage post-migration, and (2) offer staged credits/retainer to soften the uplift during months 1–3 of the new term.

High level asks: 35% capacity uplift, interim price hold through 2027-09-30, and a credit schedule that scales down over the first quarter. If you can sketch an option we can take to our CFO (Tom) this week, that would be very helpful.

Can you loop in whoever owns pricing and CS? We want minimal friction — AuroraTech has been happy with performance and would like to keep momentum.

Thanks,
Lina Gomez
Head of Cloud Platform — AuroraTech

Attachments: none
From: vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com

Cc: vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sun, 13 Jun 2027 09:18:00 +0000
Subject: Fwd: Renewal conversation — capacity bump and price hold request

Team — forwarding AuroraTech's ask. Short summary: +35–45% expected consumption starting Aug, wants interim price lock through 9/30 and staged credits for first 3 months. They need an option for CFO this week.

Proposed owner split: Marissa — lead on the credit/retainer structure and CS onboarding plan. David — finance to model the commit/true‑up and confirm impact on ARR. Karthik — check whether any contract/legal constraints on a short-term price lock and whether we can do a conditional price-hold tied to committed uplift.

Quick suggested approach before we propose to them (we can iterate):
- 3‑month staged credit: 30% credit month 1, 20% month 2, 10% month 3 applied to overage tokens (or retainer conversion).
- Interim price lock: freeze list rates for qualifying usage up to 1.5x current committed baseline until 2027-09-30.
- Commit option: offer a 12‑month term with a 10% blended uplift discount if they sign within 15 days.

Can each of you take a bullet point and I’ll assemble an offer to send on Tues?

—Vanessa

From: vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com

Cc: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, david.kim@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 15:40:00 +0000
Subject: Proposal: Renewal + uplift concession package (draft) — AuroraTech

Lina / Tom — thanks for the context. Attached is our formal proposal (RI_Renewal_Offer_AuroraTech_20270615.pdf) and a short MAP (attached) that shows how credits apply across usage bands. Highlights:

1) Capacity uplift: we will provision a dedicated burst pool to support a 45% uplift; baseline commit 1.0x -> 1.45x for planning & autoscaling.

2) Staggered credit schedule (applies to overage tokens beyond baseline commit):
   - Month 1 (Aug): 30% credit on billed overage
   - Month 2 (Sep): 20% credit on billed overage
   - Month 3 (Oct): 10% credit on billed overage

3) Interim price lock: freeze list unit price for qualifying usage up to 1.5x baseline through 2027-09-30. If over 1.5x we will route at standard list price for excess.

4) Early-sign incentive: if AuroraTech signs the 12‑month renewal and uplift by 2027-06-30, we will apply a 10% blended discount to committed spend (applies to the first 12 months).

5) Operational commitments: canary rollout plan, 24/7 on-call for first 30 days post-migration, and a weekly sync for the first 6 weeks.

Attachments: RI_Renewal_Offer_AuroraTech_20270615.pdf, AuroraTech_MAP_v1.xlsx

Please review the attached draft and let me know which parts you want tightened or presented differently to your CFO / procurement. We are open to a conditional price-lock structure if that helps procurement sign faster.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@auroratech.com>
To: vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@auroratech.com>, procurement@auroratech.com
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 10:02:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Proposal: Renewal + uplift concession package (draft) — AuroraTech

Vanessa — thanks for the fast turnaround, the structure looks promising. A couple of follow-ups from Tom and procurement:

- Can we tighten the interim price lock window to 2027-09-15 instead of 9/30? We need to align with our internal budget reforecast on 9/16.
- Procurement prefers credits that apply to gross invoice rather than only overage buckets (they want simpler accounting). Can you run the cost model if credits were applied as invoice-level credits for the first three months instead?
- Legal has a few redlines on the standard terms (we attached a marked document). We typically avoid conditional language that creates retroactive credits unless agreed in the SOW.

I've attached our redline: AuroraTech_Redline_20270616.docx. Tom is available for a 30-minute call Thurs if that helps.

Thanks — Lina
From: vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com
To: Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@auroratech.com>, Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@auroratech.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, david.kim@redwoodinference.com, karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sat, 19 Jun 2027 20:30:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Proposal: Renewal + uplift concession package (draft) — AuroraTech

Lina / Tom — really appreciate the clarity. Quick answers and next steps:

1) Interim price lock window: we can move the price-lock to 2027-09-15 (agreed) for qualifying usage up to 1.5x baseline. We'll reflect that in the amendment.

2) Credits as invoice-level credits: Marissa, can you run two samples (A: overage-applied credits; B: invoice-level credits) and share the delta for Aug/Sep/Oct by EOD Monday?

3) Legal redlines: Karthik — we'll intake AuroraTech_Redline_20270616.docx and propose a tracked-change amendment that preserves their accounting preference while protecting Redwood against retroactive exposure.

4) Sign path: David — can you confirm whether we can offer the early-sign 10% blended discount subject to a 15-day execution window and produce the updated invoice schedule for the CFO? We will also prepare a short SOW addendum for the burst pool.

Operationally: Marissa will set up a 30-minute runbook sync this week; I'll send a calendar invite for Wed at 11am PT. After legal confirms language, we will send a DocuSign-ready amendment (link below).

DocuSign preview: https://www.docusign.com/auroratech/RI-Renewal-3479
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567/DEAL-3479

Thanks everyone — we'll aim to have an amendment ready for signature by 2027-06-23 so AuroraTech hits your internal deadline.

—Vanessa
